summary: Iteration 16 verifies the new NAPS2 scanner feature end-to-end (backend + web frontend) plus a regression quick check on Word button + ZIP export. Backend: all 15 scanner pytest tests pass (/app/backend/tests/test_scanner.py). GET /api/scanner requires auth (401 without token) and returns {key, course_id, course_name}; auto-creates a persistent URL-safe key on first call. PUT /api/scanner {course_id} sets the folder and returns 404 for unknown/foreign course. POST /api/scanner/key regenerates the key — verified the old key then returns 401 on /scanner/upload. GET /api/scanner/script?base=<url> returns application/octet-stream with Content-Disposition attachment copythat-skanna.cmd, embeds the user's current key AND <base>/api/scanner/upload, uses CRLF line endings exclusively (every \n is preceded by \r); invalid base => 400; requires auth. POST /api/scanner/upload with X-Scan-Key header and multipart 'file' creates a NEW document in the chosen folder with title 'Skanning YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' (Europe/Stockholm) and pages in queued/processing/error/done statuses; works for JPG (1 page) and PDF (2 pages); falls back to 'Inkorg' when no folder is set; wrong key => 401; missing key => 401; empty file => 400. Regression: GET /api/documents/{id}/export?format=zip returns a valid ZIP (PK header, 9938 bytes) containing BOTH .docx, .txt, AND .pdf entries. All 9 Word-preview + email-zip tests from iter15 still pass. Frontend web (390x844, logged in as test@copythat.app via /api/auth/verify + localStorage['copythat.token']): /settings renders the testID 'scanner-card' with title 'Skanner (NAPS2)'. The folder chip testID 'scan-folder-<courseId>' is tappable; tap turns background from rgba(0,0,0,0) to rgb(47,93,80) (primary brand green), is persisted via PUT /api/scanner (GET confirms course_id = tapped course), and the highlight remains after full page reload. 'scan-key' text displays the current 32-char key; 'scan-new-key' button changes it to a new value in the UI (verified via inner_text comparison). 'scan-script' button triggers a real browser download event with suggestedFilename 'copythat-skanna.cmd' (1484 bytes); downloaded content contains CRLF, the current scan key, and the /api/scanner/upload path. Regression UI: on /doc/{id} the 'download-docx' (Word) testID is present in the toolbar. No red-screen, no PAGEERROR, no uncaught exceptions. Code review of /app/backend/server.py scanner section (lines 307-432): clean, DRY (_scanner_info helper reused by GET/PUT/POST/key and upload), proper Pydantic (ScannerIn), proper HTTPException codes (400/401/404/413/422/502), zoneinfo for Stockholm time, secrets.token_urlsafe(24) for keys, base validated with regex. Code review of /app/frontend/app/settings.tsx: clean (248 lines), all testIDs present, downloadScript uses fetch -> blob -> <a download> + revokeObjectURL cleanup, Bearer token sent via header. No deprecated expo packages found in settings.tsx or server scanner section (expo-clipboard is current).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:312-320 _scanner_info is the single source of truth for the scanner payload — reused by every endpoint. DRY.
server.py:330 own('courses', body.course_id, user) correctly 404s on unknown or foreign course before PUT persists anything. Correct.
server.py:397 base validated with ^https?://[\w.\-:]+$ — simple but adequate; prevents obviously bad input and would reject spaces/paths. Good.
server.py:401 Response(body.replace('\n', '\r\n').encode('utf-8'), media_type='application/octet-stream') with Content-Disposition filename='copythat-skanna.cmd' — perfect for Windows cmd execution.

server.py:408 user lookup via scan_key is a direct equality on the users collection; given the key is 24-byte URL-safe (~192 bits) this is effectively unguessable. Consider adding an index on scan_key for performance when the user base grows.

server.py:417 fallback to inbox course works but calls the FastAPI route function `inbox(user)` directly — not an issue functionally but a slight smell (mixing HTTP handler with internal helper). Verified behavior: a user with no scan_course_id auto-gets a doc in 'Inkorg' folder.
server.py:420 title uses Europe/Stockholm tz, perfect for Swedish users.
settings.tsx:83 base = API_URL.replace(/\/api$/, '') | window.location.origin — handles the trailing /api cleanly and falls back correctly for native. Good.
settings.tsx:84-90 downloadScript uses fetch+blob+<a download> pattern and revokes the object URL after 5s. Correct.
settings.tsx:167-176 the 'highlighted' state is derived from scanner.course_id or the local Inkorg course id when scanner.course_id is null — so 'Inkorg' is always highlighted by default (good UX).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 7 UI assertions in the scanner playbook pass on web 390x844 + regression ZIP+Word button verified)

seed_data_creation: Scanner tests create their own TEST_Scanner_* courses + 'Skanning ...' documents and delete them in teardown. The UI playwright run creates TEST_UI_Scanner_Folder course and TEST_UI_Regression_Doc, both deleted at the end.
